capacitors.source: Metal plate over thin oxide (X2) on a doped region contacted along its bottom edge (clock's nor). With X2's 5 pF pad capacitance, the value fits the datasheet's Figure 1, 32 kHz at 1 Mohm, to a period of 2 R C ln((VDD + 0.6 V) / (VDD / 2)): the pad diodes stop X2 0.6 V outside the supplies.
